clips.title: 体育资产配置向大众开放，冠军产品降低门槛
title_lines: 体育资产配置向大众开放
普通市场参与者也能参与体育权益

subtitles.en: I think the way that I came in, I was never able to get comfortable, never felt like I had job security.
subtitles.zh: 我入行时，始终无法安心，总感觉没有职业保障。

subtitles.en: And once you get into kind of that mindset, you just keep striving for the next thing.
subtitles.zh: 一旦陷入那种心态，就会不断追求下一个目标。

subtitles.en: So 10 years later, I was able to leave pretty accomplished. Awesome story, man.
subtitles.zh: 十年后，我带着满满的成就离开了。真棒的故事。

subtitles.en: Talk to us about the Champion Fund. What is it and what are you trying to accomplish here?
subtitles.zh: 跟我们聊聊冠军基金吧。它是什么？你们想达成什么目标？
en_highlights: what are you trying to accomplish

subtitles.en: Sure. So the Champion Fund is an interval fund.
subtitles.zh: 好的。冠军基金是一只间隔基金。

subtitles.en: So it's an SEC Register fund. And the mission and vision here is to make the sports asset class accessible to every investor.
subtitles.zh: 它是SEC注册基金，使命和愿景是让每位市场参与者都能参与体育资产类别。

subtitles.en: Over the last decade or so, we've seen more and more news and more and more conversation around the sports asset class and how it's growing.
subtitles.zh: 过去十年左右，我们看到越来越多关于体育资产类别及其增长的新闻和讨论。

subtitles.en: But it's typically been institutional investors only. And what we know, me personally, being the product on the field as a player, transitioning into the investment world,
subtitles.zh: 但通常只有机构市场参与者能参与。我个人作为球员在场上，后来转入**界，

subtitles.en: having some ownership and operational experience for about seven years.
subtitles.zh: 拥有约七年的所有权和运营经验。

subtitles.en: So I've been able to see this asset class from a bunch of different lenses. And the one thing that you realize is the biggest value catalyst for the asset class itself,
subtitles.zh: 所以我从多个角度观察了这个资产类别。你意识到，该资产类别最大的价值催化剂

subtitles.en: the athletes, the fans, the coaches administrators.
subtitles.zh: 运动员、球迷、教练和管理人员。

subtitles.en: They create all the value but get none of the equity in it. So the Champion Fund is really a vehicle that makes that whole asset class accessible to every investor.
subtitles.zh: 他们创造了所有价值，却没有获得任何权益。冠军基金让这类资产对每个市场参与者都变得触手可及。

subtitles.en: How's the matter of response? It's been a really good response.
subtitles.zh: 市场反应如何？反应非常好。

subtitles.en: So right now we're out trying to secure those anchor investors, those institutional investors to kind of anchor the fund.
subtitles.zh: 目前我们正在争取锚定市场参与者和机构市场参与者来为基金定锚。

subtitles.en: But the concept has been really well received.
subtitles.zh: 但这一概念已经广受好评。
